series.name: Mighty Morphin' Power Rangers Re-Ignition
series.overview: Five teenagers are chosen from their small town of Angel Grove by an intergalactic being and a futuristic robot to become legendary heroes, the Power Rangers after an ancient evil is freed from a space dumpster, hidden on the moon. This is an "enhanced" version of the first season, upscaled to 1080p and with added ending segments.
